title: Austin Housing, Child Care & Urban Homesteading
summary:
*   City leaders engaged in strategic discussions regarding future housing goals and the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) process.
*   Specific focus areas for development and planning included the 11th Street and Montopolis neighborhoods.
*   Discussions also covered key initiatives like expanding child care facilities and promoting urban homesteading programs.
